+def _run_coroutine(coroutine):
+    try:
+        previous_loop = asyncio.get_event_loop()
+    except RuntimeError:
+        previous_loop = None
+    loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
+    try:
+        asyncio.set_event_loop(loop)
+        return loop.run_until_complete(coroutine)
+    finally:
+        loop.close()
+        if previous_loop is None:
+            try:
+                asyncio.set_event_loop(None)
+            except (TypeError, RuntimeError):
+                pass
+        else:
+            asyncio.set_event_loop(previous_loop)
+
+
+class _PreparedRequest:
+    def __init__(self, method, url, headers=None, body=None):
+        self.method = method
+        self.url = url
+        self.headers = headers or {}
+        self.body = body
+        self.hooks = {}
+        parsed = urlsplit(url)
+        self.path_url = parsed.path
+        if parsed.query:
+            self.path_url = "{}?{}".format(self.path_url, parsed.query)
+
+
+class _ResponseProxy:
+    def __init__(self, session, method, url, headers=None, params=None, data=None, json_data=None):
+        self._session = session
+        self._method = method
+        self._url = url
+        self._headers = headers or {}
+        self._params = params
+        self._data = data
+        self._json_data = json_data
+        self._result = None
+
+    def __enter__(self):
+        self._result = self._load()
+        return self
+
+    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc_val, exc_tb):
+        return False
+
+    def json(self):
+        return self._result
+
+    def _load(self):
+        scheme = urlsplit(self._url).scheme
+        adapter = self._session._adapters.get(scheme)
+        if adapter is not None:
+            body = self._data
+            if body is None and self._json_data is not None:
+                body = json.dumps(self._json_data)
+            request = _PreparedRequest(self._method, self._url, headers=self._headers, body=body)
+            response = adapter.send(
+                request,
+                stream=False,
+                timeout=None,
+                verify=True,
+                cert=None,
+                proxies=None,
+            )
+            try:
+                return response.json()
+            finally:
+                close = getattr(response, "close", None)
+                if callable(close):
+                    close()
+        return _run_coroutine(self._request_async())
+
+    async def _request_async(self):
+        headers = dict(self._session.headers)
+        headers.update(self._headers)
+        async with aiohttp.ClientSession(headers=headers) as session:
+            async with session.request(
+                self._method,
+                self._url,
+                params=self._params,
+                data=self._data,
+                json=self._json_data,
+            ) as req:
+                return await req.json(content_type=None)
+
+
+class _SessionProxy:
+    def __init__(self, headers=None):
+        self.headers = dict(headers or {})
+        self._adapters = {}
+
+    def mount(self, prefix, adapter):
+        self._adapters[prefix.rstrip(":/")] = adapter
+
+    def get(self, url, params=None):
+        if params:
+            separator = "&" if "?" in url else "?"
+            url = "{}{}{}".format(url, separator, urlencode(params, doseq=True))
+        return _ResponseProxy(self, "GET", url)
+
+    def post(self, url, data=None, headers=None, json=None):
+        return _ResponseProxy(self, "POST", url, headers=headers, data=data, json_data=json)
+
+    def delete(self, url):
+        return _ResponseProxy(self, "DELETE", url)
